body.name: mhat_a
body.def: For every Borel cell \(D\subseteq[0,1]\), let \(N_a(D)=\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbf 1\{X_i\in D,A_i=a\}\). Set \(\widehat m_a(D)=N_a(D)^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^nY_i\mathbf 1\{X_i\in D,A_i=a\}\) when \(N_a(D)>0\), and set \(\widehat m_a(D)=1/2\) when \(N_a(D)=0\); hence \(\widehat m_a(D)\in[0,1]\).
